page.notes: The first letter of "Ordo" is a decorative bullet ornament, not transcribed. The word "vtrum" in the Passio entry is hard to read at this size. "Patristicæ" is a doubtful reading. The entry "Passio ... 537" is read as printed. The first entry's line-end and the catchword are as printed. Doubtful readings: "praedit" (printed as "pratedit", marked [?]) and "cuí". Two entries carry spelling that may be printer's error: "iub" in "Possibilia omnia num iub potentiam Dei cadant" and "impotentia" in "Potentia rationem impotentia", both left as printed. The entries are set in italic throughout, with page numbers in roman.
